program='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    points = [(r, c, value) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, value in enumerate(row) if value]

    candidates = []
    for key in (lambda r, c: c - r, lambda r, c: r + c):
        groups = {}
        for r, c, value in points:
            groups.setdefault(key(r, c), []).append(value)
        conflicts = sum(len(values) - max(values.count(color) for color in set(values)) for values in groups.values())
        candidates.append((conflicts, len(groups), key, groups))

    _, period, key, groups = min(candidates, key=lambda item: (item[0], item[1]))
    pattern = {}
    for offset, values in groups.items():
        pattern[offset % period] = values[0]

    return [[pattern[key(r, c) % period] for c in range(w)] for r in range(h)]
'''
p.write_text(program)
print(p.read_text())
